It lacks the specific seed distribution and skin sheen of a real strawberry, suggesting a generative artifact in material rendering.

The pink wafer on the right appears extremely thin and somewhat translucent, lacking the rigid structural integrity expected of a baked good. Its edge blends slightly into the background/topping, suggesting minor boundary bleeding.
